utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the timing, but Saturday on the front porch is the plan. If you can, please bring basic tools and a bit of tape—nothing too bulky.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday on the front porch works for me. I’ll bring a basic tool kit and some tape.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thank you. I’ll firm up the timing and let you know if anything changes before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik — can you also ask if anyone can bring a drill and some screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll ask around for a drill and some screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. If you can bring a few tools, that’d be great, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll bring a few tools and stop by Sunday at the community center to see what else they need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — that sounds perfect. I’m still getting things sorted for Saturday at the front porch, so I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. If you hear anything new about what they still need, please let me know and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any updates I hear about what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate that. I’ll be at the front porch Saturday, ready to help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. If you can spread the word and point people my way, I’ve got the porch set up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, quick update — the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll spread that along too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for the update, Jules — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll adjust my plans and keep getting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, it’s at the community center on Sunday now. I’m a little fuzzy on the house list, though — could you remind me which ones are on it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, it’s still this Saturday at the front porch, not Sunday. I can remind you of the house list if you’re free to help there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — I must’ve mixed that up. I can help this Saturday at the front porch; please remind me of the house list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Hana — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. We still need help keeping track of supplies and any last-minute needs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — what time on Sunday, and which houses are on the list? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure on the exact time yet, but I can check and get back to you. I’ll also pull together the house list so you have everything you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. The drive’s on Sunday at the community center now — just bring the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the wrench set and screwdriver to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Gus. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — I’m still spreading the word for Saturday’s repair drive, and I’ll pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Quinn — thanks for spreading the word. If you hear what else they still need, just let me know and I’ll help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear what else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Sunday at the community center—that’s the next stop. If anything changes, just flag me at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center is set, and I’ll keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. I’m headed there later, so just let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an eye on what we still need and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so Sunday at the community center, not today or Saturday on the porch?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right — Sunday at the community center, not today or Saturday on the porch. I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive—what else do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and we still need someone to help sort supplies and set up tables. If you can bring tools too, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help sort supplies and set up tables, and I’ll bring some tools too. Just let me know what time on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Happy to help on Saturday at the front porch — just let me know what you need me to do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks so much, Rey — could you help sort donations and greet folks from about 10 to noon? I’m working around the school schedule, so that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can do that from 10 to noon. Just point me to the donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—we’re still on for the repair drive today, right? And if you hear anything else from the community center, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on, but it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll swing by later and ask if they need anything beyond the front steps and railing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks for the update—so it’s Sunday now at the community center, and you’ll let me know if they need anything beyond the front steps and railing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia—what’s the exact time at the community center, and which houses are on the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still firming up the exact time, but it should be Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the house list once I’ve confirmed the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia—please send me the time and house list as soon as they’re set, and I’ll help make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ve got it noted for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Opal — thanks for keeping track. I’ll let folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye on it and update if anything changes again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center now — I almost forgot it moved. I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Noah — even a quick hand would help. I’m still checking who can sort items and set things up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I can help sort a bit if I make it over. Just remind me again if the time changes, okay?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Please bring the extension cords if you can. It’s on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — the extension cords would be a big help. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the extension cords Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep passing along any new details I hear, especially if they still need more hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if we need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli — I’m still rounding up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you know anyone who can come by, please send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone I find your way. For now, I’m still planning on Saturday at the front porch unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Eli — I’ll keep spreading the word too, and I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli—if you can, please bring any basic tools or spare parts this Saturday to the front porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — I’ll bring what I can this Saturday to the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. I’ll see you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — what repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll sort the drop-off and pickup details next.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks for the update — I can help spread the word if you need. Just let me know the time and anything else folks should bring.
